answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a bridge tag. The wharf cap is checked at intake and relic reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
